div.head: Ps Cn for 6
div.ab: Habeat quilibet primariorum quolibet anno de nostra warda, quam [uu]ichin Angli appellant, duos equos, unum cum sella, alterum sine sella, unum gladium, V lanceas, unum cuspidem, unum scutum et ducentos solidos argenti.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 621 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: Let each of the chief men have each year from our ward [store], which the English call [uu]ichin [?], two horses, one with a saddle, the other without a saddle, one sword, five lances, one spear, one shield and two hundred shillings of silver.

note.seg: Die vier Grafschafts-Forstrichter, die Verf. meint, stehen jedenfalls weit tiefer als der oder die zwei Oberrichter des Forsts in ganz England. Der Ritter erhielt unter Heinrich II. 8 Pf. Tagessold; Round Archaeolog. Jl. 59 (1902), 148

The four county forest judges whom the author means rank in any case far below the one or two chief justices of the forest for the whole of England. Under Henry II a knight received 8 pence a day in pay; Round Archaeolog. Jl. 59 (1902), 148
